description: This file is a React component serving as a main container for the application. It handles routing, lazy loading of components, theme switching, language setting, and initial data loading, acting as the core entry point for a Next.js + React-based app.

methods.name: useHtmlLang
methods.description: Sets the language attribute of the HTML document based on the current locale.

methods.name: useHasHydrated
methods.description: Custom hook to determine if the component has mounted and hydration has completed.

methods.name: loadAsyncGoogleFont
methods.description: Dynamically loads Google Fonts stylesheet based on app configuration.
